data.displayName: AF 400 Tab
data.description:
AF 400 Tablet is used to treat fungal infections of the mouth, throat, vagina, and other parts of the body including fingernails and toenails. It kills fungi by destroying the fungal cell membrane thereby stopping the growth of fungi.


AF 400 Tablet should be taken in the dose and duration as prescribed by your doctor. It should be swallowed whole and can be taken with or without food. The dosage and length of treatment will depend on the condition you are being treated for. Sometimes this will be in cycles of use and non-use. To get the most benefit, take this medicine at evenly spaced times and continue using it until your prescription is finished, even if your symptoms disappear after a few days. If you stop treatment too early, the infection may return and if you miss doses you can increase your risk of infections that are resistant to further treatment. Tell your doctor if the infection does not get better or if it gets worse. Avoid taking antacid treatments within one hour before or two hours after you take it.

The most common side effects of this medicine include stomach pain, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, headache, and nausea. You could ask your doctor about ways of preventing or reducing these effects. Stop taking medicine and inform your doctor if you notice signs of an allergic reaction such as rash, swelling of the lips, throat, or face, swallowing or breathing problems, dizziness, and nausea.

Do not take AF 400 Tablet if you are pregnant unless your doctor has told you to. Inform your doctor if you have a history of heart failure, a weak immune system (including HIV/AIDS), kidney problems, or liver problems such as yellow skin (jaundice). This medicine may not be suitable for you. If your course of treatment is for more than a month, your doctor may monitor your liver function. This medicine may make you dizzy so do not drive or operate machines until it is safe.

This makes accumulated flakes easier to remove during rinsing and can improve penetration of the antifungal ingredient across a heavily scaled scalp.

Unlike a routine cosmetic dandruff shampoo, Saldan combines antifungal and scale-removing actions in one medicated treatment. It may be particularly useful when dandruff is accompanied by stubborn flakes, oiliness, itching or visible scalp buildup.

The shampoo is suitable for adult men and women when recommended by a healthcare professional. data.displayName: Streax Heat Protection Hair Spray for Frizz Control & Styling Protection
data.description:
Streax Heat Protectant Spray is a lightweight styling essential designed to help protect hair from the visible effects of heat styling while improving smoothness, shine, and manageability. Whether you regularly use hair dryers, straighteners, curling wands, or blow brushes, this heat protection spray helps support healthier-looking hair during styling routines.

Repeated exposure to high temperatures can contribute to dryness, roughness, frizz, and styling-related breakage. Streax Heat Protectant Spray helps create a protective layer around hair fibers, reducing direct heat exposure while helping maintain softness and flexibility.

Unlike traditional styling products that can leave hair feeling sticky or heavy, this lightweight mist helps improve styling performance without weighing hair down. The formula helps smooth the hair cuticle, reduce flyaways, and enhance shine for a polished finish.

Suitable for straight, wavy, curly, colour-treated, and chemically processed hair, the spray integrates easily into daily styling routines. Regular use may help maintain hair quality, support smoother texture, and reduce visible frizz even in humid environments.

Ideal for:

• Heat-styled hair

• Frizzy hair

• Dry hair

• Colour-treated hair

• Chemically processed hair

• Hair exposed to frequent styling

For best results, apply before every heat styling session and combine with a nourishing haircare routine.
